57275-the-juvenile-scrap-book-for-1849-a.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. “How I wish gran’pa was here!” exclaimed little Susan Fielding, one day to her mother, who was busying herself about household affairs, and could not devote as much of her time to her children, Susan and Robert, as usual.

arxiv-1807-11280.title: Game of Orbits: A Gaming Approach to Neptune’s Discovery
arxiv-1807-11280.creator: Siddharth Bhatnagar, Jayant Murthy
arxiv-1807-11280.description: A 2018 arXiv research paper by Siddharth Bhatnagar, Jayant Murthy. One reason that the planet Neptune will be remembered for, is to do with the fact that it was the first planet whose existence was postulated before being observed. This was based on analysing deviations in Uranus’ orbit. The present study gives a brief account of the history behind the discovery of Neptune, looking at the same, through the conflicting lenses of France and Britain.

arxiv-2105-11651.title: Fast and Accurate Scene Parsing via Bi-direction Alignment Networks
arxiv-2105-11651.creator: Yanran Wu, Xiangtai Li, Chen Shi, Yunhai Tong, Yang Hua, Tao Song, Ruhui Ma, Haibing Guan
arxiv-2105-11651.description: Abstract In this paper, we propose an effective method for fast and accurate scene parsing called Bidirectional Alignment Network (BiAlignNet). Previously, one representative work BiSeNet [ 1 ] uses two different paths (Context Path and Spatial Path) to achieve balanced learning of semantics and details, respectively. However, the relationship between the two paths is not well explored.

arxiv-2106-13643.title: Mechanism of electron-beam manipulation of single dopant atoms in silicon
arxiv-2106-13643.creator: Alexander Markevich, Bethany M Hudak, Jacob Madsen, Jiaming Song, Paul C Snijders, Andrew R Lupini, Toma Susi
arxiv-2106-13643.description: Abstract The precise positioning of dopant atoms within bulk crystal lattices could enable novel applications in areas including solid-state sensing and quantum computation. Established scanning probe techniques are capable tools for the manipulation of surface atoms, but at a disadvantage due to their need to bring a physical tip into contact with the sample.

arxiv-2301-10535.title: Gate-controlled Magnetotransport and Electrostatic Modulation of Magnetism in 2D magnetic semiconductor CrPS 4
arxiv-2301-10535.creator: Fan Wu, Marco Gibertini, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, Ignacio Gutiérrez-Lezama, Nicolas Ubrig, Alberto F. Morpurgo
arxiv-2301-10535.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Fan Wu, Marco Gibertini, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, Ignacio Gutiérrez-Lezama, Nicolas Ubrig, Alberto F. Morpurgo. Using field-effect transistors (FETs) to explore atomically thin magnetic semiconductors with transport measurements is difficult, because the very narrow bands of most 2D magnetic semiconductors cause carrier localization, preventing transistor operation. Here, we show that exfoliated layers of CrPS 4 –a 2D layered antiferromagnetic semiconductor whose bandwidth approaches 1 eV– allow the realization of FETs that operate properly down to cryogenic temperature.

arxiv-2407-19300.creator: Sanchit Sinha, Guangzhi Xiong, Aidong Zhang
arxiv-2407-19300.description: Abstract . Interpretability of Deep Neural Networks using concept-based models offers a promising way to explain model behavior through human-understandable concepts. A parallel line of research focuses on disentangling the data distribution into its underlying generative factors, in turn explaining the data generation process.

arxiv-2410-16402.title: Universal time evolution of string order parameter in quantum critical systems with boundary invertible or non-invertible symmetry breaking
arxiv-2410-16402.creator: Ruhanshi Barad, Qicheng Tang, Wei Zhu, Xueda Wen
arxiv-2410-16402.description: Abstract The global symmetry, either invertible or non-invertible, has been extensively studied in two dimensional conformal field theories in recent years. When the theory is defined on a manifold with open boundaries, however, many interesting conformal boundary conditions will fully or partially break such global symmetry.

arxiv-2505-09023.description: Abstract Quantum correlations in the degree of polarization of freedom of the two-photon system have been extensively studied and form our current understanding of the quantum nature of our world. arxiv-2506-16590.title: Energy-Based Transfer for Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2506-16590.creator: Zeyun Deng, Jasorsi Ghosh, Fiona Xie, Yuzhe Lu, Katia Sycara, Joseph Campbell
arxiv-2506-16590.description: Abstract Reinforcement learning algorithms often suffer from poor sample efficiency, making them challenging to apply in multi-task or continual learning settings. Efficiency can be improved by transferring knowledge from a previously trained teacher policy to guide exploration in new but related tasks.

plos-pone-0002417.description: PLOS ONE research article. plos-pone-0007906.title: Genome-Wide Analysis of Immune Activation in Human T and B Cells Reveals Distinct Classes of Alternatively Spliced Genes
plos-pone-0007906.creator: Yevgeniy A. Grigoryev, Sunil M. Kurian, Aleksey A. Nakorchevskiy et al.
plos-pone-0007906.description: PLOS ONE research article. Alternative splicing of pre-mRNA is a mechanism that increases the protein diversity of a single gene by differential exon inclusion/exclusion during post-transcriptional processing. While alternative splicing is established to occur during lymphocyte activation, little is known

pmc-10494757.title: Complete plastome of Coelastrum microporum Nägeli (Scenedesmaceae, Sphaeropleales)
pmc-10494757.creator: Chanhee Lee, Joshua T. Cooper, Francesca Moroni, Ana M. Salim, Chaehee Lee, Trisha Spanbauer, Edward C. Theriot
pmc-10494757.description: The genus Coelastrum Nägeli (Sphaeropleales; Scenedesmaceae) is a diverse genus of green algae with potential biotechnical applications. A sound understanding of its phylogeny will be a useful tool for predicting the distribution of traits that may enhance its utility, and may lead to a better understanding of its evolution and ecology. Here we present the plastome of Coelastrum microporum.

pmc-11596542.title: Isolation, Antibacterial Activity and Molecular Identification of Avocado Rhizosphere Actinobacteria as Potential Biocontrol Agents of Xanthomonas sp.
pmc-11596542.creator: Jesús Rafael Trinidad-Cruz, Gabriel Rincón-Enríquez, Zahaed Evangelista-Martínez, Luis López-Pérez, Evangelina Esmeralda Quiñones-Aguilar
pmc-11596542.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Actinobacteria, especially the genus Streptomyces, have been shown to be potential biocontrol agents for phytopathogenic bacteria. Bacteria spot disease caused by Xanthomonas spp. may severely affect chili pepper (Capsicum annuum) crops with a subsequent decrease in productivity. Therefore, the objective of the study was to isolate rhizospheric actinobacteria from soil samples treated by physical methods and evaluate the inhibitory activity of the isolates over Xanthomonas.

pmc-12752954.title: Examination of the influence of stimuli eccentricity on the inhibitory control in a simon task within virtual reality
pmc-12752954.creator: Dan Bürger, Luisa Peintner, Florian Heilmann, Stefan Pastel, Kerstin Witte
pmc-12752954.description: In certain scenarios, suppressing automated responses and initiating alternative actions is necessary to respond appropriately to stimuli. This process, known as inhibitory control, can be investigated using the Simon task, where stimuli positions are typically task-irrelevant but affect reaction times when stimulus location and response direction differ (Simon effect).

pmc-12985057.title: Effects of Aquatic Exercise on Sleep Quality in Patients with Chronic Diseases: A Meta-Analysis
pmc-12985057.creator: Shuzhang Zhou, Ming Fang, Billy Chun-Lung So, Hei Wa So, Paul H. Lee, Siushing Man
pmc-12985057.description: Background/Objectives: This study systematically synthesized the evidence on the effectiveness of aquatic exercise (AE)-based interventions for improving sleep quality in patients with chronic diseases and identified key moderating factors. Methods: A meta-analysis of 11 randomized controlled trials sourced from Google Scholar, PubMed, Web of Science, Embase, Cochrane Library, and Scopus (published between 2016 and 2025) was conducted.

pmc-13103810.title: Friedelin Enhances Gelatin/Nanohydroxyapatite Scaffold Performance by Inhibiting Osteoclastogenesis and Promoting Osteogenesis
pmc-13103810.creator: Nguyen Minh Trang, Da Eun Lee, Eun-Nam Kim, Gil-Saeng Jeong
pmc-13103810.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Friedelin is a naturally occurring compound known for its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and wound-healing properties, positioning it as a potential candidate for the development of advanced biomaterials in bone tissue engineering. In this study, we first investigated the biological effects of friedelin (FD) on osteoclast differentiation induced by RANKL (receptor activator of nuclear factor kappa-Β ligand)-induced osteoclast differentiation, as well as its protective role in osteoblast function under lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-induced inflammatory conditions.

pmc-13185971.title: Overlapping Cytomegalovirus Infection and Inflammatory Pouchitis After Liver Transplantation: When Antivirals Alone Are Insufficient
pmc-13185971.creator: Brody M. Fogleman, Ryan O’Leary, Tiffany Baker, Erin Forster
pmc-13185971.description: Cytomegalovirus (CMV) is an infrequently reported etiology of secondary pouchitis in patients who have undergone total proctocolectomy with ileal pouch-anal anastomosis. We present the case of a patient with chronic antibiotic-dependent pouchitis, ulcerative pancolitis, primary sclerosing cholangitis, and orthotopic liver transplant who presented with hematochezia. Pouchoscopy showed ulcerated mucosa, and histopathology with immunohistochemistry confirmed CMV pouchitis.

pmc-13254033.title: Preterm Birth and Perinatal Mortality During the COVID‐19 Pandemic Period: A Systematic Review and Meta‐Analysis
pmc-13254033.creator: S R Peart, R Haj‐Yahya, M Nugent, O Ganbold, L Harbinson, Cheong JLY, B J Manley, C L Whitehead
pmc-13254033.description: BackgroundPreterm birth rates may have been affected during the COVID‐19 pandemic but the impact of this on perinatal morbidity is unknown.AimTo review the impact of the COVID‐19 pandemic on rates of preterm birth and perinatal mortality.MethodsMedline, Embase, and online pre‐prints were searched from Jan 2020 to Oct 2022.

pmc-13266304.title: Effect of Nurse-Led Intermittent Bladder Catheterization on Recurrence of Female Urethral Stricture following Urethral Dilatation: A Randomized Controlled Trial
pmc-13266304.creator: Farah Naz, Samina Kausar, Jamshed Rahim, Shazia Taj
pmc-13266304.description: Background & Objective:Female urethral stricture (FUS) is a rare but significant cause of bladder outlet obstruction, often leading to urinary retention, recurrent UTIs and other complications. Conventional treatment like urethral dilation provides temporary relief but has a high recurrence rate.

pmc-13487318.title: Health-related social needs and referrals for genetic evaluation among young children
pmc-13487318.creator: Hadley Stevens Smith, Kristin N. Ray, Lina Ghaloul Gonzalez, Janel Hanmer
pmc-13487318.description: Health-related social needs (HRSNs) may impact the receipt of genetic services, but the mechanisms are not well established. We aimed to evaluate the relationship between pediatric patients’ HRSNs and referrals for genetic evaluation. We analyzed HRSN survey data collected during clinic visits across 47 primary care offices for children <3 years of age.

Congress finds that— (1) the distribution of goods and services to consumers in the United States requires the free flow of currency, bullion, securities, supplemental nutrition assistance program benefits, and other items of unusual value in interstate commerce; (2) the armored car industry.
